item.title: Version 2.1.4
item.description:
What's new in 2.1.4

  • Auto-update. The app now checks for new versions automatically and offers a one-click install — no more manual downloads.
  • Live cross-user updates. When a teammate uploads or deletes a file, your Finder reflects the change within about half a second instead of needing a refresh or remount.
  • Live access control. When the admin grants or revokes a drive in Users & Access, the producer's app picks it up without signing out.
  • File sizes update correctly after upload — no more stuck-at-0-bytes display.
  • Users & Access modal got a frozen first column so the user name stays visible while you scroll through drives.
